result.title: AI in Industrial Design: An Accessible Introduction
result.summary: The literature consistently establishes that AI—spanning decision support, optimization, computer vision, natural language processing, and generative systems—augments rather than replaces the industrial designer across all process stages, serving as a powerful assistive tool for parametric customization and assistive product development while requiring sustained human oversight to manage inherent risks of bias, opacity, error, and creative homogenization.
